info.prompt: A high-stakes digital gambling table suspended in a vast void-black cathedral of bone and gold filigree, where neon cyan and electric magenta synaptic pathways pulse with rhythmic vitality, casting shifting glows across translucent crystalline dice that glow from within like bioluminescent lab specimens, while a terminal-style hacker overlay flickers with commit logs at the base—every detail illuminated by the oscillating heartbeat of an unseen medical monitor, reinforcing the tension between ancient gothic ritual and cybernetic futurism.
